root_cause.text: `__build_packet_message()` in `net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c` manually constructs the `NFULA_PAYLOAD` netlink attribute using `skb_put()` and `skb_copy_bits()` instead of standard helpers, which fails to initialize the trailing NLA alignment padding bytes and leaks stale heap memory to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the manual allocation of `nla_total_size(data_len)` via `skb_put()` with `nla_reserve()`, which properly zeroes out the padding bytes. The commit message confirms that "The trailing nla_padlen(data_len) bytes... are never initialized, leaking stale heap contents to userspace".

bic_trace_step.reason: The code in this commit still manually constructs the NFULA_PAYLOAD netlink attribute using skb_put with nla_total_size(data_len) and manually assigns nla->nla_type and nla->nla_len (lines 593-595).
